desc: Lake fairy spirit: pale blue and white gown flowing into long ribbons, three layers of translucent blue butterfly wings per side with gold edges, a gold fishing-hook scepter, a shell crown. Chibi 16-bit pixel art character sprite, big head, small body, right-facing 3/4, 1px navy outline, 2-3 flat shades, no gradients, no noise, no glow, no halo, no shadow. Black void face with small eyes. Palette lavender, white, violet, gold.
